**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 02:08
- [USER] Each number represents an Arabic pronunciation.
- [USER] Example: 3anjad = anjad
- [USER] Example: zene5 = zenekh
- [USER] Example: m5alal = mkhalal
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "3inko janzeer bill beit" would be a way of spelling out the Arabic phrase "عنكو جنزير بل بيت" using this numbering system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In standard Arabic, the phrase "3inko janzeer bill beit" would be pronounced "`inko janzeer bill beit."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The phrase "You have a monkey in the house" is the meaning of "`inko janzeer bill beit."
